info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Document Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Application Document Retrieval API allows consumers to access specific documents associated with loan applications. This endpoint serves as a means to retrieve essential documents by providing the unique identifiers for both the loan application and the document. Typical users include loan officers, customer support representatives, and automated systems needing to verify loan documentation. This API is crucial for streamlining the loan processing workflow and ensuring that relevant information is readily available during the approval process.

get.summary: Retrieve documents related to a specific loan application.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve all documents associated with the loan application identified by the specified resource ID. It provides details necessary for reviewing or managing the loan application documentation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer Token authentication, specifically using JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Users must include a valid JWT token as a Bearer token in the authorization header of their requests to access secured endpoints.
